title: How Container Ship Crews Eat, Shower & Sleep for Months at Sea
intro: A ship as long as four football fields, thousands of containers, and only about 25 people who live on board for months. Here's how container ship crews eat, shower and sleep.
asof_line: Rules from the Maritime Labour Convention 2006; survey figures as of 2025.
